title: Potato: modeled ₹358/qtl left, Perumbavoor → Athirampuzha
summary: January 2021: reported potato prices at Perumbavoor and Athirampuzha imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 18 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹358 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 986 same-variety market pairs screened for potato in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Athirampuzha report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor (Kerala) and Athirampuzha (Kerala) both reported potato prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 18 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor reported a median ₹2,500 per quintal. Athirampuzha reported a median ₹3,200 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹600/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹600 per quintal, and Athirampuzha was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 64 km by road
scenes.caption: 64 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹14/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹290 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹131 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Athirampuzha report, the rule selects 18 of 18 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹358 per quintal (₹194 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Potato route from Perumbavoor to Athirampuzha was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹35,800, or ₹19,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to potato
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹14/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Potato route from Perumbavoor to Athirampuzha was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹35,800, or ₹19,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Potato: modeled ₹399/qtl left, Palayam → Kayamkulam
summary: October 2021: reported potato prices at Palayam and Kayamkulam imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹399 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 1,188 same-variety market pairs screened for potato in October 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kayamkulam report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: October 2021
scenes.caption: Palayam (Kerala) and Kayamkulam (Kerala) both reported potato prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Palayam reported a median ₹1,750 per quintal. Kayamkulam reported a median ₹2,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹700/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹700 per quintal, and Kayamkulam was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 269 km by road
scenes.caption: 269 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~5 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹58/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹413 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹272 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kayamkulam report, the rule selects 24 of 24 modeled shipping days. 24 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹399 per quintal (₹260 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Potato route from Palayam to Kayamkulam was positive on 100% of matched days in October 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹39,900, or ₹26,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to potato
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹58/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Potato route from Palayam to Kayamkulam was positive on 100% of matched days in October 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹39,900, or ₹26,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
